title: WarGreymon (ST1-11) Security Attack double-counts the formula keyword
notes: Minimal repro of a (now-fixed) engine bug. P1 field stack is Koromon/Agumon/Birdramon/MetalGreymon/WarGreymon (top): WarGreymon with 4 digivolution sources, on P1's turn (the [Your Turn] aura is active). WarGreymon grants Security A. +1 per 2 sources => +2 => checks 3 security total. RESOLVED 2026-06-08: parse_printed_keywords extracted the <Security A. +1> token out of the conditional formula text as a flat SecurityAttackPlus(1), which raw_security_strike added on top of the base-inclusive security_attack_fn formula (=3) => 4. Fixed in combat/mod.rs by subtracting the top card's own face <Security A.> when it has a security_attack_fn formula. NOTE: the scenario assertion vocabulary still has no security-attack kind, so the only machine assertion here (stack_top) passes; the authoritative regression test is cards_behavioral/st1/wargreymon_security_attack.rs::wargreymon_real_data_clean_stack_checks_three_on_your_turn (asserts effective_security_strike == 3 from full_card_data). See docs/RUST_ENGINE_GAPS.md.
